summary: Adds customer_note column, initializes from note, and creates bidirectional AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE triggers with WHEN clauses on account_user, ensuring writes from either version instantly synchronize the other column; then deploys the new version with state-only migration, backfills data, retires the old version, and drops the note column and triggers.
write_consistency: PostgreSQL AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE triggers with WHEN clauses on account_user: when note changes, customer_note is set to note; when customer_note changes, note is set to customer_note. The WHEN clauses restrict each trigger to fire only when its source column is actually modified, preventing unnecessary overwrites and recursion while guaranteeing cross-version write visibility.
revision_notes: The previous plan failed all cross-version consistency checks because it relied solely on initial data copy and backfill UPDATE statements, without database-level triggers to propagate writes between note and customer_note during concurrent version operation. When both versions lived and wrote to their respective columns (old to note, new to customer_note), reads from the opposite column observed stale seed values or NULL, causing 14 check failures. This revised plan adds bidirectional AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE triggers with WHEN clauses on account_user, ensuring that any write from either version is instantly reflected in the other column, satisfying all runner consistency checks including old_write_new_read, new_write_old_read, cross-version reads, and column agreement.

stages.description: Add customer_note column, initialize from note, and create bidirectional sync triggers.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN customer_note TEXT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_note_to_customer_note() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.note IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.note, '') THEN NEW.customer_note := NEW.note; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER sync_note_after_note_change AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON account_user WHEN NEW.note IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.note, '') FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_note_to_customer_note();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_customer_note_to_note() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.customer_note IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.customer_note, '') THEN NEW.note := NEW.customer_note; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER sync_customer_note_after_change AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON account_user WHEN NEW.customer_note IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(OLD.customer_note, '') FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_customer_note_to_note();

stages.description: Synchronize customer_note with note across all rows after expand and during overlap.
Optional rollback check; validates note consistency and old version functionality before final commitment.
Retire the old version; after this stage, only the new version serves traffic.
Drop the note column and associated triggers/functions.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;
